$comment: Rules no in-spec example can show, because the rule is about what a renderer does rather than what a document is. Each names the test that covers it instead. Read by scripts/check-example-coverage.py.

APR-CONF-001.reason: What a reader reports for a stream depends on the profiles it claims, so no one document example can state the outcome.

APR-CONF-004.reason: A statement about what an implementation claims; the harness holds each claimed profile to every case in it.

APR-CONF-006.reason: Conforming to core is answering every core case; no one document shows it.

APR-CONF-007.reason: A permission to claim a profile, which nothing can violate.

APR-CONF-008.reason: A permission to claim a profile, which nothing can violate.

APR-CONF-009.reason: A permission to claim a profile, which nothing can violate.

APR-CONF-010.reason: A constraint on a declaration, not on a document; the harness refuses a declaration that breaks it.

APR-EXPR-014.reason: A computed value staying editable is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.

APR-RENDER-001.reason: The accessible name is a property of the rendered interface, not of the document.

APR-RENDER-002.reason: Whether a placeholder is the only label is a property of the rendered interface.

APR-RENDER-003.reason: Associating help text with its control is a property of the rendered interface.

APR-RENDER-004.reason: Conveying nesting structurally is a property of the rendered interface.

APR-RENDER-005.reason: Keyboard reachability is a property of the rendered interface.

APR-RENDER-006.reason: Not blocking a save is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.

APR-RENDER-007.reason: Table cells naming their header is a property of the rendered interface.

APR-RENDER-008.reason: Presentation order is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.

APR-RENDER-009.reason: Not writing an export back is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.

APR-SEC-009.reason: Executing nothing on open is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.

APR-SEC-010.reason: Fetching nothing on open is renderer behaviour; a document cannot show it.

APR-MODEL-003.reason: A rule on what an implementation does with a response, such as saving it. A document can show the mismatch stays valid, but not an implementation refusing to save.

APR-REP-002.reason: The suite carries a document as text, so it cannot hold an encoding, a byte-order mark or a malformed byte sequence.

APR-REP-003.reason: The suite carries a document as text, so it cannot hold an encoding, a byte-order mark or a malformed byte sequence.

APR-REP-008.reason: A rule on how a reader resolves a scalar. A document cannot show a reader resolving one wrongly; the digest of each satisfying example catches it.

APR-REP-012.reason: A rule on how a reader resolves a scalar. A document cannot show a reader resolving one wrongly; the digest of each satisfying example catches it.

APR-REP-013.reason: A rule on how a reader is built. A document that would exploit an unsafe loader needs a tag, which the excluded-constructs table already refuses.

APR-REP-019.reason: The suite carries a document as text, so it cannot hold an encoding, a byte-order mark or a malformed byte sequence.

APR-REP-023.reason: A rule on what a writer emits, which no input document shows.

APR-REP-024.reason: A rule on what a reader reads a null or absent response as. A document cannot show a reader reading it wrongly; the digest of the satisfying example catches it.

APR-REP-026.reason: A rule on how a reader resolves a scalar. A document cannot show a reader resolving one wrongly; the digest of each satisfying example catches it.

APR-REP-027.reason: A rule on how a reader resolves a scalar. A document cannot show a reader resolving one wrongly; the digest of each satisfying example catches it.

APR-REP-028.reason: A rule on how a reader resolves a scalar. A document cannot show a reader resolving one wrongly; the digest of each satisfying example catches it.

APR-REP-029.reason: A rule on how a reader resolves a scalar. A document cannot show a reader resolving one wrongly; the digest of each satisfying example catches it.
